notes.title: Free to play
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

after thinking a lot about it we decided that the best thing we can do for the game is to make it free to play since it is mostly based on multiplayer and we need to build a bigger player base for the game to be enjoyable.

Thanks for the support.

notes.title: New Update 1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
New Update is ready.

-Fixed crash in machines with no support for DX11.
-Fixed and polished a bit more the AI.

This are small updates but we are planning a major update that will take a couple of months. Now, we are going to keep doing this minor updates meanwhile.

We are open to suggestions, if you want us to add a feature let us now. We are also looking for artists and level designers so if you want to join us send us a message.

Thanks.
